signals.title: Palm taxi rank, Delft (approx.): two men shot dead and one wounded in suspected taxi-related shooting, 22 Oct
signals.content: Two men were shot dead and another person wounded at the Palm taxi rank on Main Road, Delft, in the early hours of Thursday 22 October, police said. Delft police registered two counts of murder and one of attempted murder, and police believe the motive is taxi-related. Accounts of the time differ: a resident told the Cape Times of gunfire at about 03:45 and again at 04:20, while police told Cape Town Etc the shooting was reported at about 05:10. An unnamed taxi operator quoted by the Cape Times blamed a route dispute between the taxi associations CATA and CODETA; the paper says this was not independently confirmed, and both associations said they could not comment. We found no report of an arrest (checked 11 Nov). No one is named. Police statements carried by news outlets; no SAPS statement found. The map point is approximate: the rank is not mapped, so the pin is where Palm Street meets Delft Main Road, not a confirmed spot.

signals.title: Palm taxi rank, Delft (approx.): two men wounded as shots fired at taxi rank; no arrests, 28 Oct
signals.content: Two men were wounded when shots were fired at the Palm taxi rank in Delft at about 07:00 on Wednesday 28 October, according to police. Police are investigating two counts of attempted murder and the discharge of a firearm, and no arrests had been made (Cape Argus, 28 Oct). Police described the shooting as between taxi drivers. Hundreds of commuters ran for cover and police closed the rank. On 29 October the Western Cape police commissioner, Sizakhele Dyantyi, told IOL that police had intelligence about a planned shooting in Delft and had officers at the rank when shots were fired from another part of it. No one was killed and no one is named. Accounts differ on small points: the Cape Times says Tuesday morning, but its police quote says 'this morning' and it was published on Wednesday 28 October, the date TygerBurger gives; the Cape Argus says the wounded went to hospital in a private vehicle, TygerBurger says by another taxi. It is the second shooting at this rank since 22 October; sharing a rank is not, on its own, a link. The map point is approximate: the rank is not mapped, so the pin is where Palm Street meets Delft Main Road, not a confirmed spot.
